items.title: Forrest Gump

items.title: Forrest Gump
items.old_question: What object floats away from Forrest's feet into the sky at the film's conclusion?

items.title: Forrest Gump

items.old_question: What is the name of Jenny's son revealed in the film's ending?

items.title: Forrest Gump
